title: Enhancer-targeting CRISPR screens at coronary artery disease loci suggest shared mechanisms of disease risk.
authors: Ramste, Markus; Weldy, Chad; Kundu, Soumya; Zhao, Quanyi; Li, Daniel; Brand, Kayla; Sharma, Disha; Ramste, Amanda; Jagoda, Evelyn; Ray, Judhajeet; Caceres, Roxanne Diaz; Galante, James; Gschwind, Andreas R; Lahtinen, Nuutti; Nguyen, Trieu; Amrute, Junedh M; Park, Chong Yong; Kim, Juyong Brian; Kaikkonen, Minna U; Stitziel, Nathan O; Steinmetz, Lars; Kundaje, Anshul; Engreitz, Jesse M; Quertermous, Thomas
journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
one_liner_zh: 该文用CRISPR筛选和深度学习模型定位CAD风险位点的增强子-基因连接，虽涉及转录因子结合但核心是基因调控而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法上深度学习仅用于染色质可及性预测，缺乏三维互作机制研究。
abstract: To systematically identify causal genetic mechanisms that confer risk for coronary artery disease (CAD) in GWAS loci, we mapped genome-wide variant-to-enhancer-to-gene (V2E2G) links in vascular smooth muscle cells (SMC). Enhancers identified by active chromatin features, and further prioritized by base-resolution deep learning models of chromatin accessibility in 108 CAD loci, were studied with CRISPRi targeting and Direct-Capture Targeted Perturb-seq (DC-TAP-seq) evaluation of 470 genes. Seventy-six V2E2G links were identified for 59 candidate CAD genes representing gene programs including epithelial-mesenchymal transformation, ubiquitination, and protein folding as well as BMP and TGFB signaling. Similar methods employed with an independent focused screen targeting one candidate locus at 9p21.3 identified 10 enhancers regulating expression of multiple genes at this location. Detailed molecular studies revealed that two enhancers mediating transcription factor binding and transcriptional regulation contribute to ancestry-specific and sex-specific risk for CAD and the surrogate biomarker vascular calcification. Together, these studies advance our identification of GWAS CAD V2E2G links across the genome, and specific mechanisms of risk at the complex 9p21.3 locus.
abstract_zh: 为系统性地识别GWAS位点中赋予冠状动脉疾病（CAD）风险的因果遗传机制，我们绘制了血管平滑肌细胞（SMC）中的全基因组变异-增强子-基因（V2E2G）关联图谱。通过活性染色质特征鉴定的增强子，并进一步利用碱基分辨率深度学习模型在108个CAD位点中基于染色质可及性进行优先排序，随后通过CRISPRi靶向和Direct-Capture Targeted Perturb-seq（DC-TAP-seq）评估了470个基因。我们为59个候选CAD基因鉴定了76个V2E2G关联，这些基因代表包括上皮-间质转化、泛素化和蛋白质折叠以及BMP和TGFB信号传导在内的基因程序。采用类似方法，针对9p21.3位点的一个候选位点进行的独立聚焦筛选，鉴定了10个调控该位置多个基因表达的增强子。详细的分子研究表明，两个介导转录因子结合和转录调控的增强子有助于CAD及其替代生物标志物血管钙化的祖先特异性和性别特异性风险。综合来看，这些研究推进了我们对全基因组范围内GWAS CAD V2E2G关联的识别，并揭示了复杂9p21.3位点风险的具体机制。
